hypothesis: At the selected r20 update-2600 checkpoint, the learned record-conditioned frequency gate itself accounts for a material part of the complete-time Marmousi improvement rather than merely accompanying 2600 additional updates of the shared mapper.
expected_mechanism: Resetting only the zero-initialized linear gate weights and bias to zero restores an exact all-ones spectral gate while preserving every head, encoder, and decoder parameter. If record-specific spectral emphasis caused the gain, this identity-gate ablation must worsen complete 401-frame Marmousi error and preferentially worsen the middle/high spectral metrics.
primary_metric: complete 401-frame Marmousi relative-L2 difference between identity-gate and learned-gate inference on the same checkpoint

acceptance.rationale: The threshold is 10% of r20's observed absolute Marmousi gain versus its parent: 0.0531370224 - 0.0490344556 = 0.0041025669.

failure_signal: The identity-gate minus learned-gate Marmousi difference is below 0.0004103, or the learned gate worsens Marmousi. In that case the shared-network continuation, not spectral gating, explains nearly all r20 improvement.

single_conceptual_variable.name: learned_frequency_gate_at_inference
single_conceptual_variable.ablated: the same two tensors set to exact zero, yielding an all-ones softmax gate
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: checkpoint, all non-gate parameters, model structure, normalization, train triplet, all 401 stored times, travel-time field, metric implementation and device
